subject: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire@twinlabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@twinlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff

Hi Monica / Tessa —

Quick handoff for TwinLabs (attached SOW + mutual action plan). We closed the deal last week (DL-2026-1198) and the customer is aiming to be live with a 1.0 integration by end of Q1. High-level context below, then action items.

Deal summary:
- Product: Redwood Hosted + Dedicated for production traffic (two models: base-gen + re-ranker).
- Committed monthly throughput: 25M tokens/month for year 1.
- Security: They require SOC 2 evidence and IP allowlist for IP ranges (details in the security questionnaire we shared).
- Primary technical contacts: Claire Zhang (platform lead) and Tom Reyes (SRE).

Key risks / expectations:
- Timeline is tight — they want an internal kickoff next week and a public integration demo in ~4 weeks.
- We agreed to provide an initial latency test deck and a recommended batching/quantization profile before kickoff.
- Procurement has signed; SOW attached. There is a standard 30-day acceptance window in Section 3.

Action items (recommended owners):
1) CS kickoff and onboarding plan — Monica (owner)
2) Runtime sizing and environment provisioning — Vivek (infra lead)
3) Integration checklist & sample prompts — Rafael 
4) Schedule kickoff (customer availability below) — Monica to propose times

Customer availability (from latest call):
- Week of Dec 13: mornings PST (9–11am) best; PST preferred.

Attachments: TwinLabs_SOW_v1.pdf, TwinLabs_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx

Notes for CS: please review the SOW section on acceptance tests (p9) — the customer is sensitive to token accounting for caching. I left a few inline comments in the MAP doc (Drive link below).

Thanks team — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
https://redwood.inference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire@twinlabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@twinlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff

Thanks Rafael — received and reviewed. Monica here; I’ll take ownership of the CS plan and kickoff.

Immediate next steps from my side:
- I’ll review the SOW acceptance criteria and confirm test cases by EOD Monday (Dec 13).
- Propose three kickoff times for next week (Dec 14–16) by tomorrow morning.
- Draft a 30/60/90 onboarding checklist and share with internal owners (Vivek, Rafael) before the kickoff.

Vivek — pinging you for environment provisioning estimates. Can you confirm required GPU profile for the two-model setup and whether we can provision a staging cluster for baseline latency tests by Dec 15? If not, what’s realistic?

Claire / Tom — Monica from Redwood CS. Rafael and I will coordinate the kickoff; would you prefer Dec 14 or Dec 15 PST mornings?

Cheers,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff

Monica — quick infra note.

We can provision a staging cluster with the requested dual-model layout (one gen, one re-ranker) by EOD Dec 15 if we use a standard A100x2 node pool and allow autoscaling burst for the first two weeks. Estimated ramp cost for staging (first 14 days): ~$4,500 — I’ll put together a short ops delta doc and share in the Drive folder.

If customer wants single-node lower-cost profiling (for latency only), we can have a small experiment ready by Dec 13 morning. Recommend we run both: a quick single-node profile to confirm baseline latency and then a multi-node staging run to validate throughput at expected concurrency.

Vivek
Infra Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Zhang <claire@twinlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@twinlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 12:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff

Monica / Rafael — thanks for the summary. Dec 14 at 9:30am PST works for Claire and Tom (we blocked 9:30–10:30). That slot is preferred.

A couple of ask-aheads for kickoff:
- We’d like a brief run-through of the acceptance tests and token accounting during the call.
- Can you share example prompts and any expected max token lengths ahead of time? That’ll help our SREs prep realistic load tests.

I’ve attached the internal network allowlist that our security team prefers to use for onboarding (see attachment in my reply). Looking forward to the call.

— Claire
Claire Zhang
Platform Lead | TwinLabs
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@twinlabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@twinlabs.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Transfer: TwinLabs onboarding — owners, milestones, kickoff

Claire / Tom — confirmed for Dec 14, 9:30–10:30am PST. I’ve attached the kickoff agenda and a short primer with sample prompts and token-length expectations. Please see attached: TwinLabs_Kickoff_Agenda.pdf and TwinLabs_Sample_Prompts.txt (also uploaded to the Drive folder).

Agenda highlights:
- 10m introductions and goals
- 15m acceptance criteria & token accounting walkthrough (Rafael + Monica)
- 20m infra & provisioning plan (Vivek)
- 10m integration checklist & next steps (Monica)
- 5m Q&A and scheduling of follow-ups

Internal note: Monica (owner) — after the kickoff I’ll post the 30/60/90 checklist in the Drive and set up the weekly sync cadence (30 mins, Wed mornings). Rafael — can you send the final signed SOW PDF to finance and cc me?

Attachments referenced: TwinLabs_Kickoff_Agenda.pdf; TwinLabs_Sample_Prompts.txt

Thanks everyone — looking forward to working with TwinLabs.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
